title: Cryptographic consent attestations
description: Records that a wallet has cryptographically attested to one or more off-chain legal documents identified by their keccak256 content hashes. Pattern: off-chain document semantics, on-chain anchor for shared reference integrity. Multi-valued — an agreement can bind to several documents simultaneously (e.g., ToS + Privacy Policy + NDA + custom merchant-buyer terms). Each entry preserves the (consenter, documentHash, documentVersion, documentTitle) tuple needed by counterparties, auditors, and arbitrators to reason about shared references over time. Consenter address is recoverable from the EIP-712 signature on the AttestationCoordinator call (not stored in content). Append-only: revocation is a separate off-chain process, not a content mutation; future revisions require figaro-consent-v2.

fields.name: documents
documentHash
fields.description: keccak256 of the canonical document text. 32-byte content anchor; any byte-level change rotates the hash.

fields.name: documentVersion
fields.description: Semver-style version identifier (e.g., '1.0.0', '2025-04-29'). Bounded to prevent griefing via unbounded calldata.

fields.name: documentTitle
fields.description: Human-readable document name (e.g., 'Terms of Service', 'Privacy Policy'). Bounded for shared-reference legibility.
Non-empty list of consent-referenced documents. Each carries its own hash + version + title.
